description: Cartographie des lignes de bus, tram et des stations de tram is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données regroupe les trois jeux de données concernant les lignes de bus, les lignes de tram et les stations de tram. Chaque jeu de donnée est accessible via l'url présente dans l'onglet Tableau. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are bus, CTS, filaire, ligne, ligne tram, tram. The portal shows 3 records. The portal shows 2022-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
